rnnoise.wasm
------------
RNNoise (Xiph.Org / Jean-Marc Valin) - BSD 3-Clause
WebAssembly derlemesi: @shiguredo/rnnoise-wasm (Shiguredo Inc.) - Apache-2.0

Bu ikili dosya @shiguredo/rnnoise-wasm 2025.1.5 paketinden cikarilmistir.
Emscripten glue koduna ihtiyac duymaz; sadece 3 import ister:
  env.__assert_fail, env.emscripten_resize_heap, wasi_snapshot_preview1.fd_write
Bu importlar src/renderer/worklets/rnnoise-processor.js icinde stub'lanir.
